response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG(CAST(g - l AS REAL) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM t) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_wins - m.mean_wins AS gap FROM t CROSS JOIN m WHERE t.avg_wins > m.mean_wins ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
